title: Domain manifest
description: One domain: its task, its vector axes, its facets, the assets that each style of the domain must have (rule 5 of the curation rules) and the knobs that vary a style (rule 6).

assets.description: The asset library of a style in this domain. Each style must have each asset. The check finds the file and, for an asset that a model renders, the prompt.

type.description: The asset type, for example hero, pattern-tile, icon-sheet, mark-set, specimen.

purpose.description: What the asset is for, in the standard of the domain.

made_by.description: model: an image model renders it from a prompt; the prompt is in the manifest entry. code: a script draws it from the style data; the generator is the prompt.

file.description: The path from the repository root. {id} is the style id; {part} is each item of parts.

parts.description: For an asset of more than one file, for example a moodboard of tiles.

manifest.description: The render record that holds the prompt and the canvas of each file. Required when made_by is model.

entry.description: The dotted path of the record in the manifest, for example images.{id}.

generator.description: The script that makes the asset.

input.description: Only for an asset that `npm run build` makes: the field of the style that the generator reads. The check finds this field, because the file does not exist before the build.

canvas.description: The permitted canvas sizes in px. Empty for an asset with no canvas (CSS).

knobs.description: The knobs that vary a style of this domain. Each style gives its own range for each knob in `permutations`.

kind.description: colour: a hex value. length: a number in the unit. number and integer: a plain number. enum: one of options.

token.description: The authored token that holds the default of the knob. If it is set, a style does not repeat the default in permutations.

drives.description: The tokens or the facets of the style guide that the knob changes.
